name: Purple Ventures
decision_note: Brno-based pre-seed/seed VC (member of Purple Holding); second fund Purple Ventures 2 had raised over CZK 700m by March 2026 in a still-open raise towards EUR 40m and invested in Kilde (Oct 2025), Rightcharge (Oct 2025, Sep 2026) and Fether Labs (May 2026).

evidence.quote: We are a venture capital fund investing into CEE+ tech-enabled innovations in pre-seed and seed stages.
Z hlediska oborového zaměření se soustředí na digitální zdraví, moderní energetiku, takzvanou creator economy či bezpečnost.
Od svého založení získal fond přes 700 milionů korun (30 milionů euro) od 52 investorů a doposud proinvestoval 250 milionů korun (10,2 milionu euro).
Do společnosti nyní investuje jedenáct milionů korun také český fond Purple Ventures společně s mezinárodními investory, včetně Chapter One a programu a16z Scout Fund firmy Andreessen Horowitz.

Ten nyní dostal novou investici – dvanáct milionů korun mu poslali z fondu kvalifikovaných investorů Purple Ventures 2, dalších sedmnáct pak přidalo sedm investorů fondu prostřednictvím speciální účelové společnosti.
The round was joined by Purple Ventures, Blackwood Ventures, and Unruly Capital.
And that’s where the £500K follow-on round we led alongside BlackWood Ventures and Purple Ventures comes in handy.
A cílí v něm na 40 milionů eur (jednu miliardu korun), z čehož asi 350 milionů korun poskytne skupina Purple zakladatelů Davida Kašpera, Jakuba Nytry a Filipa Řehoře.
Letos pak plánujeme fundraising ukončit na avizovaných 40 milionech euro.

analyst_notes: Capital: Purple Ventures 2 had raised over CZK 700m (EUR 30m) from 52 investors by 2026-03-12 (Finance.cz), with a target of EUR 40m and fundraising planned to end in 2026; the fund was launched in 2024 (CzechCrunch 2024-06-27), so the 2026 status is recorded as fund event 'other' and capital is the amount raised to date, not a final close. Ticket: the homepage strategy block shows '€250k to €400k' labelled 'initial ticket size, later follow-ons' (label is a separate element, so only the range is quoted). Geography: site says 'CEE+' (CEE plus selected non-CEE deals, e.g. UK, Singapore). Sector focus from CzechCrunch 2024 (digital health, modern energy, creator economy, security); the site describes 'purpose-driven technology startups'. Investments: Fether Labs - Purple invested CZK 11m (its own ticket; round size not given), source text written by Fether Labs and published by Euro.cz (2026-05-27, also Svět průmyslu 2026-07-08); Kilde - CZK 12m from FKI Purple Ventures 2 plus CZK 17m from fund investors via an SPV. Rightcharge rounds evidenced by the co-investor's (Soulmates Ventures) releases. Fund vehicle 'Purple Ventures 2' (FKI) not found by name in ARES, so only the manager entity is listed. [revision 2026-10-25 after review: capital basis changed from latest_fund_size to interim_close (CZK 700m is the amount raised to date by 2026-03-12 in a raise still open; Finance.cz quotes the plan to end fundraising in 2026 at the announced EUR 40m, e10); the Purple Ventures 2 fund event changed from 'other' to interim_close (CZK 700m, 2026-03-12) and a target event EUR 40m added (CzechCrunch 2024-04-02, e9). No final close found. Latest-activity check: the Rightcharge GBP 500k follow-on (Soulmates Ventures page published 2026-09-07) names Purple Ventures as co-investor in a round Soulmates led, and Purple's own homepage lists Rightcharge among its portfolio (founder testimonial; news item on 'Purple Ventures' investment in Rightcharge'), so it is Purple's own participation (amount of Purple's share undisclosed). Note: finance.cz serves a gzip-compressed body even without Accept-Encoding; the quotes e4/e10 are present after decompression, but a fetcher that does not decompress will report them as not found.]
